summary.text: Kaley Dvorak, an Undeclared voter running as a Democrat, is a candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a data analyst who, in a Ballotpedia survey, listed closing the housing gap, reforming education funding and addressing childcare, health care and energy costs as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Dvorak graduated from Manchester Central High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2011 and a graduate degree from Tufts University in 2019.
Her career experience, according to her Ballotpedia profile, is as a data analyst.
Ballotpedia reports that Dvorak advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary as a write-in candidate.
In the survey, she described her focus as bringing an affordable future to the people of New Hampshire, and named health care and education as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
